SEEKING WORK - Maine preferably, even better if it's Midcoast, but also Remote

Full resume: http://brad.xyz/

Software Engineer with eight years of experience developing geospatial and location-aware web apps and tools using Javascript, Python, C# .NET, Java, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, SQLite, Geoserver and GE Smallworld. I like to work with a wide variety of tools and love to learn new ones.

I love maps and I've helped companies all over the US improve their GIS, collect new data, improve their data, and to use their existing data more effectively or in new ways.

Primary developer of a product for GPS-based gas leak survey tracking that has recorded 75 million GPS points representing 75,000 miles of surveying. I was involved in all aspects of product development/management from day one.
